Eat the whole city for pocket change
intro: Korat's Michelin list is all Bib Gourmand, which is the best kind of problem: real quality, gentle prices. Laab Somphit rounds it out at around 40 baht a plate.

faq.q: How many Michelin restaurants are in Nakhon Ratchasima?
faq.a: Eight in 2026, and every one is a Bib Gourmand. There are no starred restaurants here yet, so the whole list is about great food at honest prices.

faq.q: Which Korat dish should a first-timer try?
faq.a: Kai Yang Saeng Thai for grilled chicken and Pa Pleung Mhee Kratok for mee korat noodles are the two flavors tied to this city's name. With one meal to spare, start there.

faq.q: What is the cheapest Michelin spot in Korat?
faq.a: Laab Somphit, at roughly 40 baht a plate, is the lightest on the wallet. Nub follows close behind with noodles around 60 to 80 baht.

faq.q: Where can I sit down for a relaxed meal?
faq.a: Banmai Chay Nam serves riverside Thai food and Krua Suwimol does Thai-Chinese, both good for a long family lunch. Sow Jeck is a longtime local Thai kitchen worth a stop too.

faq.q: How do I get around to these restaurants?
faq.a: Most sit within Korat city, so a short drive or a local ride connects them quickly. Two or three stops in a day is very doable.
